rule.statement: Vacating from the entirety of Lot No.1 is not necessary since the Plaintiff is only claiming 1/4th share of the land.
rule.supporting_quote: In allotting the 1/4th share that the Plaintiff is entitled to, due regard shall be had to the land on which the Defendants have constructed permanent dwelling units, and such land shall be excluded from the land allotted to the Plaintiff.
